name: founder-skills
title_zh: 创始人专用：把模糊想法逼成可执行决策的追问器
tagline_zh: 别让「再想想」拖垮你。它专治创始人脑中那团乱麻——每次对话都逼你分清事实、假设和行动，三问之内露出下一步该踩的坑。
tagline_en: Stop 'let me think'. It dissects your founder brain fog—separating facts, assumptions, actions in 3 rounds.
why_zh: 不给你建议，只拆你的前提。每个追问都指向你话语里没说的那个缺口。
why_en: No advice, only premise-breaking. Each probe targets the unspoken gap in your words until you say 'so that's my block'—more.
limit_zh: 只服务创始人角色，且默认你已有一家真实公司或产品；不覆盖融资路演、法律合规、财务税务。它逼你决策。
limit_en: Only for founder role with a real company/product. No fundraising, legal, or tax. Forces decisions but won't own consequences—skip if thin-skinned.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Founder's drill: force vague ideas into executable decisions
